title: stainless flatware 20 pc
text: stainless flatware 20 pc. An awesome deal for the price. Weighty... shiny... balanced.  I purchased these because my stainless is rounded and my husband finds them hard to hold onto with his big fingers... so... I looked for a more "flat" design and these fit the bill.  Simple, but not cheap looking in anyway and even better in person.  I have seen sets in person that were 3x the price and not nearly as nice as these.  The knife is printed on one end and the reverse is all shiny... no print.  The forks (both salad and dinner) and the spoons (soup and regular) have a design printed on both sides. The spoons and forks do have a curve to the back side... BUT.... it is very subtle and VERY smooth.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful, but man... these were really a steal in my opinion.  They arrived quickly (I have prime) and in perfect condition along with other items I had ordered, in a box, individually wrapped and sorted (dinner forks, salad forks, spoons and knives rubber banded together)  Hope this info and pics have been helpful!
